g.text: Save my sign-up and skills to the database (issue #44)
Implemented user story: "As a new student, I want my account and the skills I pick
at sign-up saved to the database so that my profile is still there after the app restarts."
Runs with `npm start`. On GitHub Pages there is no API, so the screens fall back to localStorage.
Show the message under each field
(built-in: shared row; custom: owned by the student)
If PostgreSQL is unreachable, Prisma throws a connection error
and the API answers 503 with a clear message instead of failing silently.
